body_text:
Given a relation $R$ on $X$, its reflexive, symmetric, or
transitive closure is the smallest relation on $X$ containing
$R$ with the named property. The reflexive--transitive closure
relates $x$ to $y$ exactly when there is a finite $R$-path from
$x$ to $y$, allowing a path of length zero.
